operations.description: An angle-bracket placeholder sitting in a shell command position is not a placeholder to bash -- it is an input REDIRECTION. An agent copy-pasting this line runs the command with its arguments swallowed and stdin redirected from a file literally named after the placeholder. Quoted, it parses, still reads as a placeholder, and fails loudly instead of strangely if pasted verbatim.

edits.find: git branch -D agent/<slug>              # only after merge or explicit abandon
edits.replace: git branch -D "agent/<slug>"            # only after merge or explicit abandon
